description: Outdoor display at the museum's site on Dien Bien Phu street; local reporting associates it with pilot Nguyen Thanh Trung. Left outdoors without cover and corroded; the museum has sought restoration funding since 2024. The museum's outdoor collection is scheduled to move again, to 24 To Huu street.
One of the Hueys in the museum's outdoor park; heavily corroded. First of the museum's UH-1s.
